blocks.text: Pinoy Big Brother Collab 3.0 housemates Mikee Quintos and Raheel Bhyria apologized for making insensitive gestures during a recent livestream. Viewers previously called out the pair after perceiving their actions as mocking persons with disabilities (PWDs). During the show’s Nov. 23 episode, Big Brother—fondly called Kuya—summoned Mikee and Raheel separately to the confession room. He helped them understand how their behavior hurt viewers and stressed the value of empathy and respect. READ: Mikee Quintos, Cianne Dominguez sorry for insensitive joke in ‘PBB’ Both housemates clarified that they never intended to offend anyone.
